name: dataforseo-mcp
description: DataForSEO MCP wrapper: searchable API docs plus normalized calls to the official server. 4 tools.

tools.name: docs_index
tools.description: Fetch the DataForSEO API documentation index (llms.txt), optionally filtered by section.

tools.name: docs_list_sections
tools.description: Return available DataForSEO API documentation section names.

tools.name: docs_search
tools.description: Fetch DataForSEO API documentation from a documentation URL.

tools.name: api_request
tools.description: Make an authenticated request to the DataForSEO API.

username.title: DataForSEO API login
username.description: Account login (email) from the DataForSEO dashboard

password.title: DataForSEO API password
password.description: Account API password from the DataForSEO dashboard
